title: schedules.is_open
description: The moment to ask about, and nothing else (schedules#1): the schedule itself is read from the hub by the runtime (`reads`), never sent by the caller.

when.description: Optional. With an offset (`2026-08-18T08:00:00Z`, `…+02:00`) it is an INSTANT and gets converted to the business timezone; without one (`2026-08-18T10:00`) it already is the shop's own wall clock. Absent = right now.
